**Allowed origins:** `http://localhost:4200` (exact), any `*.pages.dev`, and any `*.workers.dev` subdomain.

**Where it's enforced:** `worker/src/index.ts`, inside `app.use('*', cors({ origin: (origin) => {...} }))` (lines ~20-29).

**To add a new custom domain:** edit that `origin` function — add another condition, e.g. `origin === 'https://yourdomain.com'` or `origin.endsWith('.yourdomain.com')`, inside the `if (...)` block before `return origin;`. Hono's `cors()` treats array values as exact-match strings only, so wildcard domains must go through this function (not an array).
